title: Guidelines on Disability Duration for Specific Injuries for Doctors
what_it_is: Guidelines on Disability Duration for Specific Injuries for Doctors

sections.label: Guidelines on disability duration for injuries
sections.summary: MOH will study whether specific guidance is needed, noting SMC's Ethical Code gives broad guidelines on medical certificates and light duties.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Health whether the Ministry will consider issuing guidelines on disability duration for specific injuries for the use of doctors issuing medical leave and light duties for injured workers returning to work.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: These include the type and severity of the medical condition or injury; time needed for the treatment, rehabilitation and recovery; and work requirements and workplace conditions.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The circumstances vary widely among different persons, making it difficult to come up with prescriptive guidelines.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: To guide this, the Singapore Medical Council (SMC) revised the Ethical Code which came into effect in 2017.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: This provides broad guidelines that medical certificates must be issued to patients on proper medical grounds arrived at through good clinical assessment, and doctors must not take into consideration extraneous factors, such as who pays for the consultation, what benefits the patients may receive or what employers’ preferences may be.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Also, when certifying that patients are fit to return to work but with limitations on their level of activity at work, doctors must first ensure that the patients’ work conditions allow this and, to the best of their ability, ensure that appropriate light duties are, in fact, available to the patients at their place of work.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Health (MOH) will study if it is necessary to formulate specific guidance in particular settings and seek inputs from the professional bodies.

sections.label: Consulting professional bodies on specific guidance
sections.summary: The Ministry will consult professional bodies to study whether specific guidance is feasible or practical.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: With regard to whether we will come up with any specific guidance, this is an area where we will consult professional bodies to study whether it is feasible or practical to even do so.

sections.label: MOM reviewing issue with public consultation
sections.summary: MOM has replied that it is currently reviewing the issue and will conduct public consultation.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: MOM has already given the reply that they are currently reviewing it and will be conducting public consultation on this issue.
